name: Helena by Enrich Labs
description:
Helena by Enrich Labs connects Claude to an autonomous AI marketing agent that plans and executes growth marketing across connected channels from a single chat.

What Helena does:
- Paid ads: analyzes performance and, when requested, launches, manages, and optimizes campaigns on Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok Ads.
- SEO: researches keywords and drafts or publishes blog posts and landing pages.
- Social media: drafts, schedules, and publishes posts for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, and Facebook.
- Analytics: tracks cross-channel performance and reports on traffic, leads, conversions, CPA, and ROAS.

Helena works with the brand and integrations already connected to your Enrich Labs account. Each reply returns the final answer, relevant links, actions and tools used, and a sessionId to continue the conversation.

The connector does not provide AI image, video, or audio generation.

Helena is the default agent. Enterprise plans can also route requests to Angela for email, Kai for social listening, Sam for SEO and content, or Paul for paid advertising.

The connector can also execute arbitrary shell commands in an isolated sandbox with outbound network access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Helena by Enrich Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Helena by Enrich Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agent.enrichlabs.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Helena by Enrich Labs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helena by Enrich Labs provides these MCP tools: send_turn.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Helena by Enrich Labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Helena by Enrich Labs in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Helena by Enrich Labs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helena by Enrich Labs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Helena by Enrich Labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Helena by Enrich Labs is developed by Enrich Labs. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
